title: Industry unemployment with end labels
intent: Compare monthly unemployment in manufacturing, construction, and finance and label each industry's newest dated observation directly, independent of input order.

source.title: Observable Plot select transform — multi-series end labels

ai.create: Create a responsive three-industry UTC line chart from the industries dataset's original date, industry, and unemployed fields. Give each industry a stable color and directly label its newest dated observation without depending on input order or reshaping the observations.
ai.maintain: Move the direct labels from the newest dated observation to the oldest dated observation of each industry while retaining industry colors, inferred callback data, and readable label space.
